title: Bouncing Ball Simulator
description:
Create a class called `BouncingBall` that simulates a ball falling under gravity and bouncing off the floor.

The class should be initialized with:
- height: initial height above the floor (in meters)
- velocity: initial vertical velocity (in m/s, positive = upward)
- restitution: coefficient of restitution (default 0.8, determines energy kept after bounce)

The class should provide these methods:
- update(dt): Update the ball's state after a time step dt (in seconds)
- get_height(): Return the current height above the floor (in meters)
- get_velocity(): Return the current vertical velocity (in m/s)
- get_bounce_count(): Return the number of times the ball has bounced
- get_kinetic_energy(): Return the current kinetic energy
- get_potential_energy(): Return the current gravitational potential energy
- is_at_rest(): Return True if the ball has essentially stopped bouncing

Physics background:
- Gravity pulls the ball downward with acceleration g = 9.8 m/s²
- When the ball hits the floor (height ≤ 0), it bounces back with reversed velocity
- The coefficient of restitution determines how much velocity is retained after each bounce
- Kinetic energy depends on mass and velocity (assume mass = 1 kg)
- Potential energy depends on height (assume mass = 1 kg)
- The ball is 'at rest' when its maximum height after a bounce is very small (< 0.01 m)

Your simulation should correctly handle bounces and energy loss.
